text: dsh-plugin-finance-data 是面向 DSH agent 的金融计算插件，通过 Cordis 注册 finance_data 工具，并可选加入金融提示词指导。它提供数字、货币、百分比及中文万亿格式化，计算简单、对数和年化收益、估值与盈利比率、现值和终值、收益序列风险指标，也能生成定投复利计划、分析组合偏离、趋势和同业分位。工具按指定动作处理输入并返回文本与结构化结果，适合需要在 DSH 对话中完成可重复金融算术和数据质量检查的用户。安装后不需要额外密钥或外部服务。

dsh-plugin-finance-data adds a finance_data tool and optional finance guidance to DSH. It formats figures and calculates returns, ratios, value and risk metrics, investment projections, portfolio rebalancing, trends and peer comparisons. No key or external service is required.
想在 DSH 对话里快速算投资收益和年化回报。
有没有工具能把金额按货币、百分比或中文万亿格式显示？
我需要计算 PE、PB、ROE 和利润率等财务比率。
能根据本金、定期投入和利率估算未来资产吗？
帮我汇总收益序列的波动、最大回撤和夏普指标。
我想检查投资组合当前权重和目标配置差了多少。
I need to compare a financial metric with a peer group percentile.
Can DSH calculate present value, future value, or an implied rate?
dsh-plugin-finance-data 的「格式化」功能：按指定精度显示数字、货币或百分比，并可使用千分位及中文万/亿单位。通过 finance_data 的 format 动作触发，输入数值和格式选项，输出格式化文本。
dsh-plugin-finance-data 的「收益与估值」功能：计算收益、常见财务比率及现值、终值或隐含利率。调用 return、ratio 或 value 动作并传入对应数据，得到计算结果和文本。
dsh-plugin-finance-data 的「风险分析」功能：从收益率序列计算均值、样本波动率、最大回撤、历史 VaR(95) 和夏普比率。调用 risk 动作并提供至少两个收益率，可选输入无风险利率，工具返回指标摘要。
dsh-plugin-finance-data 的「投资计划与组合」功能：按本金、定期投入、频率、年利率和通胀生成定投复利计划，也可比较组合实际权重与目标并列出买卖再平衡金额。通过 plan 或 portfolio 动作提交对应参数。
dsh-plugin-finance-data 的「趋势与同业比较」功能：分析时间序列方向、极值和波动，或计算指标相对同业的 P10/P50/P90 与百分位排名。调用 trend 或 peer 动作并传入数值序列。

dsh-plugin-finance-data README · dsh-plugin-finance-data：A **finance data toolkit** for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh) agents: guaranteed-correct number formatting, return math, ratios, time value, and risk metrics. The model explains; the plugin does the arithmetic.

dsh-plugin-finance-data README · Compatibility：Tool schemas are validated against the `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` value-schema DSL at plugin load (checked against dsh-tools 0.1.0-rc.6 and 0.1.1-rc.2). Earlier releases used JSON-Schema `required` at the root of `output.schema` and closed nested objects without declared properties, which made the host abort the whole profile boot with `unsupported JSON schema: schema.required is not supported by the value schema DSL` and could reject the tool's own results. Current releases fix both; if an affected version left your DSH unable to start, remove the plugin from the profile (or upgrade) — no data is lost.

dsh-plugin-finance-data README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-plugin-finance-data
```

Restart DSH. The `finance_data` tool is registered host-wide.

dsh-plugin-finance-data README · Tool：| action | purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `format` | Number/currency/percent formatting with thousands separators and Chinese 万/亿 units |
| `return` | Simple, log, and annualized (CAGR-style) returns |
| `ratio` | PE, PB, ROE, ROA, gross/net margin, debt-to-equity |
| `value` | Present value, future value, implied rate |
| `risk` | Mean, volatility, max drawdown, historical VaR(95), Sharpe from a return series |
| `checklist` | Data-quality checklist (source, as-of date, units, definitions) |
| `plan` | DCA / compound-interest projection — future value schedule, inflation-adjusted real value |
| `portfolio` | Portfolio weights, drift vs targets, and rebalance buy/sell orders |
| `trend` | Metric time series — mean, extremes, direction (slope), volatility |
| `peer` | Value vs peer group — P10/P50/P90 and percentile rank |

dsh-plugin-finance-data README · Config：All optional, on the composition row's `config`:

| key | default | meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `personaSection` | `true` | register the finance prompt-guidance section |
| `sectionOrder` | `6` | prompt section order (persona is 0, ascending) |

dsh-plugin-finance-data README · Design：Pure logic (`lib/finance.js`) has zero DSH/Cordis imports and is unit-tested in isolation; `lib/index.js` is the thin Cordis plugin wiring the tool and the prompt section. No filesystem access — deterministic and side-effect free.

dsh-plugin-finance-data README · Roadmap：See [ROADMAP.md](./ROADMAP.md) — next five versions (v0.2.0 – v0.6.0): planning & portfolio, trends & peer comparison, cash-flow & sensitivity, bonds & FX/inflation, backtest & report export.
